title: Unique Research: Kimi March Visits Surge to 12.19M (+317% MoM)
summary: Since launching in October 2023, Moonshot AI’s Kimi Chat has stood out in the AI-assistant market with strong long-context capability. By March 2024, traffic had jumped sharply — a signal of both tech leadership and market strategy aligned with user need.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight · April 4, 2024

Since launching in October 2023, Moonshot AI’s Kimi Chat has stood out in the AI-assistant market with strong long-context capability. By March 2024, traffic had jumped sharply — a signal of both tech leadership and market strategy aligned with user need.

Traffic trajectory

Kimi Chat’s visit path is striking: from an initial 160,000 visits, to 2.92 million in February 2024, to 12.19 million in March 2024. The leap tracks a long-context breakthrough — from handling 200,000 characters to 2 million — that effectively addresses users’ information-integration problems. Tech edge let Kimi take a lead in information organization and draw heavy attention and usage.

Tech & compute

Kimi’s team uses transform-attention-based methods to focus on key points in long context and assign weights. Internal algorithm optimization keeps completeness and coherence when processing long text, raising interaction quality and efficiency. Compute support comes mainly from ByteDance Volcano Engine, NVIDIA-centric; pretraining needs 10,000+ cards. Public-cloud dynamic scale-out backs Kimi strongly.

Positioning & growth

In an age of information overload, users urgently need tools that efficiently process and integrate long text. Kimi’s long-context ability fills that gap with convenient information organization — a user-centered positioning that won market recognition fast.

Growth is not only tech innovation but also go-to-market and retention. Partnerships with industry-chain companies such as Zhangyue Technology (掌阅科技) and Huace Film & TV (华策影视) broaden scenes and lift experience. Social media, tech forums, and word of mouth bring new users; ongoing algorithm and service upgrades raise stickiness.

March spike & market impact

Comparing periods shows a steadily expanding user base. In March 2024 alone, visits hit 12.19 million, up 317% month-over-month — strong market momentum and evidence that the growth playbook works.

Kimi Chat has become a hot topic in AI circles and the secondary market. Its 2-million-character lossless context is cited as a first in the AI field and opens new possibilities for content consumption and interaction.

Despite a brief outage on March 21 under traffic surge, Moonshot moved quickly with emergency measures and multiple scale-outs — underscoring focus on user experience.

The breakout also moved stocks: related names including Huace Film & TV, Zhangyue Technology, and Jiuan Medical (九安医疗) saw market-cap gains of nearly ¥10 billion within a few trading days. Shenwan Hongyuan’s latest research note called Kimi a confirmed hit and said domestic language models had formally reached GPT-4 level — further boosting confidence in Moonshot.

Company & capital

Founder Yang Zhilin (杨植麟) and team background underpin the success. The company has closed three financings from investors including Sequoia China and ZhenFund; the latest round exceeded $1 billion, valuation $2.5 billion — among China’s foundation-model unicorns — with ample capital for further development.

Kimi heat and 2M-context capability continue to beat expectations; many evaluations use novels and book materials. Ultra-long text may broaden publishing-content scenes. Industry-chain names keep running hot. Compute/ops-related firms such as Yakong Shares (亚康股份) and Runze Technology (润泽科技) partner deeply with Volcano Engine, providing exclusive AI training and inference acceleration for Kimi.

Highly correlated media ETFs (film/TV and media) have also been strong. Investment logic: AI revolution underway; short drama, mini-program games, and other new forms proliferate; the government work report’s 2024 tasks call for deepening big-data and AI R&D/application and an “AI+” action — media as a main AI-application arena may remain a 2024 investment theme.

Outlook

Kimi will keep expanding parameters, ship multimodal models, and grow text capability fast. The company frames the current phase as experience, not yet commercialization: raise experience via larger parameters, then raise retention.

Kimi Chat’s rise marks both a tech breakthrough and market-strategy success — and points to where AI assistants are headed. With continued tech progress and market response, it is expected to hold a leading position and deliver richer, more convenient service.

Metric note

Visits = total site visit sessions, measuring traffic and visitor volume. A visit (session) is counted when a visitor views one or more pages; later pageviews stay in the same visit until the user is inactive for more than 30 minutes. Activity after 30 minutes counts as a new visit. Crossing midnight starts a new session.

— END —
